## Discover upcoming OSIG events

Explore upcoming Open Science workshops, talks,
ReproducibiliTEA journal club sessions, and community events at the
University of Oldenburg.

Click an event to see its description, location,
and registration or meeting links.

```{=html}
<style>
.osig-calendar {
  margin: 2rem auto;
  max-width: 1200px;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}

.osig-calendar iframe {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 760px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
```
